subject.title: [Feature]: Reuse release evidence for changelog-only candidates

question: Should OpenClaw make the dedicated trusted-main release-delta evidence workflow in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103632 a supported permanent release path?
rationale: This new high-trust operator mode changes which prior validation can authorize publication, so explicit maintainer acceptance of the release policy is required beyond implementation correctness.

options.title: Adopt after full proof
options.body: Accept the dedicated workflow after release-owner review and exact-head changelog-only, non-metadata rejection, and publish-consumer proof.

options.title: Start changelog-only
options.body: Narrow the first supported policy to changelog-only deltas and expand reuse after production release experience.

options.title: Keep full reruns
options.body: Reject cross-candidate reuse and continue requiring complete release validation for every candidate SHA.

recommendation.title: Adopt after full proof
recommendation.body: Accept the dedicated workflow after release-owner review and exact-head changelog-only, non-metadata rejection, and publish-consumer proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the issue and implementation and has relevant merged release-workflow history; Peter Steinberger is the strongest adjacent publish-contract reviewer.
